name: vasusheoran-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins — homelab infrastructure management, documentation, and ops tooling

plugins.name: homelab
plugins.description: Homelab management plugin — Proxmox, self-hosted services, Cloudflare tunnels. Commands for session handoffs, ops docs, behavioral guidelines, and statusline setup.

plugins.name: canvas
plugins.description: Local canvas for Claude Code — plans, UI mockups, decision docs, and diagrams as reviewable HTML workspaces with inline comments and a push review loop. Stdlib-only, localhost-only.

plugins.name: foreman
plugins.description: Orchestrated implementation workflow — foreman: plan on canvas, get approval, delegate work items to Opus/Sonnet subagents (in-process or in herdr tabs) under strict TDD; grill-me: adversarial self-review of a draft before the user sees it.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Writing-quality skills — anti-ai-writing: rules distilled from Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing' so prose doesn't read as machine-generated.
